A healthy plant based food in a heart of Hanoi
Oct 2026 • Solo
Old quarters, across the road from Starbucks. A beautiful view to the rooftops and the crossroad. Very quiet despite of many people passing by. 3 floors, level 1 to order the food, Level 2&3 - with outdoors/indoors seating area.
Food is fresh and healthy (I've attached the menu). They run out of things quite often, as the place is in high demand from healthy continous tourists. The service is great, no confused orders, which us rare here. They bring the food upstairs pretty quick. Like 10 mins wait time. A soup with a toast, a coffee and a fresh juice is about 320000 VND.

Consistently delicious and cozy
Sep 2026 • Family
I got acquainted with this cafe when I lived in Da Nang, and now I happily came here in Hanoi.

I really like the stable quality and good selection of dishes - the menu is diverse, you can always find something interesting. The location itself is also very pleasant: it is right in the tourist center, yet inside it is quiet, comfortable, and cool even in the hottest weather thanks to the air conditioning.

And a special plus for me personally is the americano. I always pay attention to coffee, and here it is consistently good in taste. For me, this is one of the indicators of the overall quality of the establishment.

Overall, a great place with good food, coffee, and a pleasant atmosphere. I highly recommend it!
